items.title: US defends Trump's Venezuela oil deal
items.description: United States President Donald Trump met oil executives at the White House on Tuesday as he tries to tame gas prices spiraling due to the Iran war, with his administration hoping the Venezuela deal could help. Cheaper oil is a priority for the Trump administration ahead of crucial US midterm elections in November.

items.title: As US steps up pressure on Iran, ordinary people say they’re paying the price
items.description: Iran’s economy was in ruins even before the war, and before U.S. President Donald Trump’s latest “D-Day” sanctions. So far, ordinary Iranians are bearing the brunt and feeling apathetic, meaning surviving leaders, for now, might face a lower risk of an uprising.
